title: Verify Office cannot edit a part (catalog is view-only)
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Office role. (this role has Catalog and Inventory = View only).
A part exists in the catalog.
steps:
1. Click Parts and open the Catalog.
2. Open a part and try to edit any field.
expected: Editing is BLOCKED: fields are read-only/disabled or saving returns a permission error. The part details remain viewable.
